cohort: Infants aged under one year in Brazil
finding: Several factors were associated with exclusive use of pacifiers, exclusive use of bottle feeding, and use of both, including maternal employment, primiparity, cesarean delivery, infant gender, birth weight, hospital accreditation, and early feeding practices.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery was associated with increased use of both pacifiers and bottle feeding.
birth_weight: Low birth weight associated with increased use of pacifier and bottle feeding
